cold_email_playbook.content: Sales Cold Email Playbook v3.1. (1) Subject line under 7 words, no exclamation marks. (2) Lead with a specific, recent personalization hook tied to the prospect's public activity. (3) One clear value proposition mapped to a stated pain point. (4) Single soft CTA (15-min call), never a hard ask. (5) Max 120 words. (6) No more than one link. (7) All first-touch emails to VP-level or above require rep review before send.
